company.name: Subtle Medical
company.shortDescription: Subtle Medical provides AI-powered medical imaging software that enhances image quality and efficiency.
company.description: Subtle Medical develops software tools that apply deep learning to medical imaging workflows. The company focuses on enhancing image quality and supporting faster imaging protocols in modalities such as MRI and PET. Its products are used to reduce scan time while maintaining diagnostic image quality in clinical settings. The software is integrated into radiology workflows to process and improve images after acquisition or during reconstruction. It is used by healthcare providers and imaging centers to support efficiency in diagnostic imaging processes.

aiResearchSummary.text: Subtle Medical is researching and developing systems and methods for medical image denoising using deep learning, harmonizing and enhancing medical images, and improving image quality in PET, MRI, and SPECT scans. Their work includes adaptive deep learning for MR image enhancement, contrast dose reduction, real-time video denoising, and automated image quality control. These efforts focus on accelerating imaging, reducing noise, and standardizing images across modalities and vendors.
